scheme_name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Education Loan Scheme (ELS)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Safai Karamchari (including wastepickers), an identified manual scavenger, or a dependent of such persons
Registered co‑operative societies of the target group are eligible
Legally constituted associations or firms promoted by the target group are eligible
Applicants must produce a certificate from a local Revenue Officer, Municipal Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, Railway Officer, or a Gazetted‑rank Government Department Head
In jurisdictions without Gazetted officers, the head of the Municipal Body may certify eligibility
Under the MS Act 2013, a manual scavenger identified in the survey does not need to provide any certificate once listed by the State/UT government
benefits_summary: Education loan up to 90% of the unit cost (maximum Rs 10 lakh for studies in India, Rs 20 lakh abroad) at 4% interest (0.5% rebate for women) with a 5‑year repayment period after course completion.
documents_required: Certificate from local Revenue Officer/ municipal officer/ cantonment executive officer/ railway officer/ gazetted‑rank government department head
Occupation certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat authority (Mukhia/Sarpanch/President)
Certificate from Regional Manager of Regional Rural Bank or Public Sector Bank
